result.description: Zenithra Holdings Pty Ltd   You Are Hired  is seeking a skilled and customer-focused  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker (ANZSCO 342313)  on behalf of our client,  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd .  About the Business:  A H R Mobile Pty Ltd operates a network of fast-paced retail outlets and kiosks located in shopping centres across Melbourne region. We specialize in on-the-spot mobile phone and tablet repairs, alongside selling a wide range of mobile accessories and protective gear.  About the Role:  In this dual-focused technical role, you will work directly from our retail outlets or kiosk stations, providing fast, reliable electronic repair services while assisting everyday shoppers. You will handle everything from basic component replacements to intricate logic board diagnostics and micro-soldering, while also upselling mobile accessories to store customers.  Work Structure: Full-time (38 hours per week).  Roster: Rotating roster aligned with shopping centre trading hours (including Thursday/Friday late-night trading and weekends).  Mobility: You must be flexible and willing to travel between various shopping centre locations in Melbourne region as scheduled.   Benefits   Competitive Salary: Market-aligned salary package + Superannuation (commensurate with trade experience).   Travel Allowance: Mileage/travel reimbursement provided when traveling between locations during work shifts.   Staff Discounts: Generous employee discounts on phone accessories, parts, and hardware.   Dynamic Work Environment: Engage directly with customers in vibrant, high-foot-traffic shopping centres.   Skills Development: Ongoing training in advanced micro-soldering and technical repair methods for the latest mobile device models.    Task & responsibilities   Device Diagnosis & Repair: Inspect, test, and troubleshoot faulty mobile phones, tablets, and wearable devices at the workbench using specialized diagnostic tools.   Component-Level Benchwork: Perform precise hardware repairs, including screen replacements, battery swaps, charging port repairs, speaker fixes, and micro-soldering on printed circuit boards (PCBs).   Accessory Sales & Customer Service: Greet customers, answer inquiries, and recommend/upsell mobile phone accessories (e.g., cases, screen protectors, chargers, and audio gear).   Quality Assurance: Test all repaired devices thoroughly before handing them back to the customer to ensure network and performance standards are met.   Workbench & Inventory Maintenance: Keep the workbench ESD-safe, clean, and organized, while managing stock levels for repair parts and retail accessories.   Multi-Site Coverage: Travel between designated shopping centre kiosks to cover shifts and manage repair volume during peak trading periods.    Qualification & experience   Qualifications:     AQF Certificate III in Electronics and Communications (UEE30920), Electrotechnology, or equivalent trade qualification; OR   At least 3 years of relevant hands-on trade experience in electronic equipment/mobile device repair (as per ANZSCO 342313 standards).     Technical Skills: Proven trade experience in mobile hardware diagnosis, precision hand-tool usage, micro-soldering, and PCB repair.   Customer & Sales Skills: Friendly, approachable attitude with experience in retail sales and customer service.   Flexibility & Mobility: Full availability for a rotating roster (including weekend retail hours) and a valid Driver’s License with reliable transport to move between shopping centre locations.   Communication: Excellent verbal and written English skills to interact with kiosk customers and document repair jobs clearly.   About Company     You Are Hired  is an Australian recruitment agency based in Melbourne, specialising in professional and trade services placements. Built on a foundation of integrity, speed, and personalised service, we partner with leading businesses across Australia to connect exceptional candidates with career-defining opportunities.  We are proud to partner with  AHR Mobile Pty Ltd —a rapidly expanding retail mobile repair and accessory business—to recruit skilled technical talent on their behalf.      Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $80000-85000   Job Publish:  23-07-2026   Job Expire:  22-08-2026  Apply on:  Electronic Equipment Trades Worker-Full time position Job here!
